disc03ClaimLifecycle.what: DISC03's 43 claims were asserted under a refused gate, released to redo the lane cleanly, and could not be re-asserted: the ledger is one-shot per subject, so re-assert returned ALREADY_RELEASED for all 43. DISC03 holds no live claim while its rows stand.
disc03ClaimLifecycle.determination: DISC03 does NOT need re-dispatch. Released is the correct end state for a completed lane, and the rows were recomputed under a passing gate on a clean tree and are byte-identical. The ledger still verifies at 512 claims and was not hand-edited to restore them.
disc03ClaimLifecycle.why: the same principle the DISC06 fix settles: a released claim is a finished claim, not a missing one. Treating release as damage would mean a lane can never be allowed to finish.
